cues.text: The playground at Naganaki Shrine, where the whole team has come along on Koromaru's walk. Yukari and Mitsuru sit side by side on a bench, talking quietly, Mitsuru with her arms folded. Nearby, Fuuka is climbing the jungle gym, with Junpei calling directions from below. Ken and Akihiko stand by the slide.
Aigis crouches in front of Koromaru with a hand held out, and Koromaru rears up and rests his front paws on top of her head. You stand watching.
